scripts.dev: npm run prisma:generate && tsx watch src/main.ts
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @maxim/contracts && npm run prisma:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @maxim/contracts && npm run prisma:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @maxim/contracts && npm run prisma:generate && jest --config jest.config.cjs --runInBand --detectOpenHandles
scripts.test:watch: npm run build --workspace @maxim/contracts && npm run prisma:generate && jest --config jest.config.cjs --watch
scripts.test:postgres-races: npm run build --workspace @maxim/contracts && npm run prisma:generate && jest --config jest.config.cjs --runInBand --detectOpenHandles --runTestsByPath src/max/chat-routing-postgres-races.spec.ts
